owner: scripts/pipeline/compile_source_palette.py (FL-4876 MANUAL-WORLD-01; outranks the seeded locale fallback)
method: Hand assessment, one street-level panorama at a time (artifacts/experiments/fl4810_aoi_street_network_boxing_20260915/captures). Per panorama the heading is corrected by eye on known landmarks (pano_overlay.py draws building bearing spans at the chosen offset; it decides nothing); each building is identified by eye; colours are read at points chosen by hand (sample.py averages the patch) on a face that is lit, never backlit or in deep shadow; storeys, ground-floor use and features are read by eye. Roofs not visible from the street are pending the GSI aerial photo.
